entry_points.text: Vmalloc init runs harness, stays only if builtin else unloads; workqueue validates items, creates unbound queue, runs scoped bench, destroys and unloads.
Drivers sweep insert/replace/reserve/erase/multi/alloc/find/pause/move/range/account/order/conflict/destroy ending vacant; main logs tallies, invalid unless all pass, no-op exit.
Bm/fsm/kmp register with find/init/pattern and linkage; init registers, exit unregisters.

exports.text: Xarray order, mark, alloc/cyclic, find-after, pause, range create, conflict search, range store, split reserve/publish/best-effort and node delete; rejects bad kinds, bounds and specials, handles wrap, sibling skip, retry and internal allocation retry.
Textsearch register/unregister/prepare/destroy/continuous, timer add/del/iterate/linked, MMIO pre/post logging and pattern pointer/len; validates names, callbacks, patterns and expiry ordering.

hazards.text: Failures negative with staged release, scope errors abort, timeout avoids hangs; bases aligned with shift/round, marks refreshed, partial replace loses size; wrap flagged, modification needs retry; wide/fan-out splits unsupported; membership/registry/sizing violations warn or fail cleanly.
External RCU, spin/list, alloc, threading, completion, time, atomic, cpumask, error, print, bug, kconfig, gfp, div, container, kmod, module, textsearch helpers elsewhere; sid only.

invariants.text: Percpu random size/align continues on fail; kvfree marker then deferred 1-arg or 2-arg; bulk alloc with map/marker/unmap count check; vrealloc marker across grow/shrink crossings; downward shuffle; clamps workers/loops and allocates vector.
Work signals completion; thread waits start then per item timestamps queue, stores ns and waits, last signals done; u64 orders; scope setter writes text and propagates errors.

Tallies runs/passes, order bound word-width if multi else one; dump empty, assert counts or logs+dumps; index helpers encode and assert ops; 1000 load/mark/clear/union checks and shrink retry-marker/bounds.

Multi span uniform, neighbours intact, overwrite replaces, clear empties; insert refused if occupied, replace only on exact match; reservation loads vacant, frees only unused; alloc lowest free with reuse, cyclic wraps; EBUSY on conflict, ENOMEM on shortage.

Conflict enumeration exact with ends readable then empty; multi find before/inside not after with bounds and erase tolerance; ordered successors, dense iteration, restart beyond bound, max once; locate with retry/pause; pause preserves order, stepping exact.
Bulk stores erasable, repeated creation safe, error survives, single entry preserved; range stores around small/page bounds, splits across levels, alignment, workingset and order checks.

Widest aligned range inside bounds; split preserves marks and counts; reservation propagates accounting, chains nodes, mem shortage on fail; sibling negative without multi/unattached else masked compare.
RCU list lookup with module ref; linear tail with exhaustion signal; timer order by expiry with efficient earliest.
Bm/fsm/kmp reject empty/overflow/invalid, handle flags/case and build tables; ubsan maps codes to fixed messages with gates and fallback.

locks.text: Retrying loads repeat from reset under read sections; walks hold exclusive guard, irq-masked for advanced multi; registry spin with RCU lookup and module ref.

state_machines.text: Worker permutes, barrier-waits, times repeats with tally, announces once then idles; harness launches, timed-waits, stops, logs and frees; scope run allocs, binds, times, flushes, joins, merges/sorts, reports throughput/p50/p90/p95.

Reads repeat from reset on retry; updates repeat until no reclaim; erase-while-advance ends vacant; split reserves then publishes with marks/tallies; shadow joins when all-values else leaves, drains deleting under lock.

Bm aligns end, matches backwards with folding, jumps max(bad,good), all-ones on end; fsm walks tokens vs blocks with recurrences, strict or resync; kmp prefix with fallback, offset past match, sentinel on end.

structs.text: Callback+20B scratch; descriptor name/routine/expected-fail with 13-case table 2 expected-fail; passed/failed/expected+avg us; thread/accounting/cycles with vector; completion/work/latency/cpu/count.
Linear len+ptr in generic block; nodes array back-ptr, slots, parent, level/pos, tallies, shadow linkage; cursors index/shift/span/node/offset/chain/LRU/callback.
Bm pattern/len+256 bad+trailing good+bytes; fsm count+tokens to bitmasks; kmp pattern/len+prefix+bytes; _A 256/_W 512 with map and 256 lookup; ASIZE 256, DEBUGP empty.
Queue bench_wq, sysfs /sys/bus/workqueue/devices/bench_wq/affinity_scope, 50000 items; scopes cpu/smt/cache_shard/cache/numa/system as value and tag; 8 type phrases, REPORTED bit31, two mask pairs.
